review_type: experiment-bridge CODE_REVIEW for CPU-only matched future-cache merge
scope: Source review plus independent CPU helper fixtures using copied actual M0 arrays. Complete merge main was not executed; the sixteen actual full-cache partitions are not claimed complete. No NN import/execution, optimizer, deployment or process signal by reviewer.

resolved_static_finding.finding: Initial COMMON_CONFIG omitted split/root/cache/regions, although the existing train_recoverability.py149-151 requires those fields consistent across TRAIN and validation. Same-policy future_policy text was checked only inside each partition, not across TRAIN/validation.
resolved_static_finding.resolution: Current source adds the four existing trainer config invariants to COMMON_CONFIG, requires source split path to match args.split, and checks same-policy TRAIN/validation future_policy text. No data, model, fallback or compatibility change.
resolved_static_finding.verification: Source inspection verifies the cross-partition checks. CPU helper fixtures on the final SHA reject injected root/cache/split/regions conflicts. The initial SHA was statically reviewed; no failed fixture run on that original SHA is claimed.

input_schema_review.markers: All2policies x2partitions x4shards require their actual job_completed.txt marker, completed receipt, expected partition and future_policy_mode before use. These are the actual collector/runner field names previously verified on CLI and full-collection sources.
input_schema_review.jobs_formats: Main reads the parent train.json/validation.json as bare ordered lists, which is the actual CPU-plan format. It does not incorrectly index them by jobs. Per-shard config.json contains jobs lists. The eight separate CLI shard job files use jobs objects but are not parsed by this merge. Actual parent lists have902TRAIN/128validation entries.
input_schema_review.split: Actual /data/gb/outputs/c1_initial_seed42/split.json has881TRAIN/98validation sequences, disjoint. Reviewer directly checked both planned job lists belong to their declared partitions. Main asserts membership/disjointness and source split path identity.
input_schema_review.arrays: Each shard must have positive consistent clip counts, finite row arrays, expected candidate-instance/future-label shapes, legal regular and raw>.84 pause masks, valid original candidate, valid last history slot, only pre-query valid history frames and exact receipt valid-action count. Keys/dtypes/nonbatch shapes must agree across shards.
input_schema_review.order: Shards are loaded in0..3order and concatenated on axis0. Combined jobs must exactly equal the predefined ordered list with no duplicate sequence/query pairs. The merge performs no deduplication, resampling, relabeling or selection.

pair_and_config_review.allowed_label_difference: Only future_iou and wrong_update_fraction may differ between teachers. Every field including those two must retain identical dtype/shape across the pair. All other arrays, including causal inputs, current/history/motion labels, action masks and prefix counts, must match exactly.
pair_and_config_review.settings: COMMON_CONFIG is checked within each partition and across every policy/partition. Main also enforces prefix epoch4/action verification, serial batch-clips1/forward-batch1, max-prefix1024, horizon3 and seed42.
pair_and_config_review.teacher_checkpoint: Existing requested checkpoint SHA check is performed against the actual prefix_model file and fixed known reference-own epoch4 SHA a165e06ffd8d0288d7db358359611d3ab1ed919941ff5fc2ccaa0cb14ddded72. No model is imported or loaded by torch.
pair_and_config_review.training_compatibility: All fields checked by the current untouched trainer's config compatibility loop are covered: split/root/cache/head/pretrained/motion_run/max_prefix/regions/future_horizon globally, and future_policy within each teacher across TRAIN/validation. Each merged config preserves prefix_policy and future_policy/mode, and supplies the complete ordered jobs/clips. Each merged receipt supplies exactly the completion fields used by load_data. Opposite teachers remain separate training arms.

write_and_reload_review.read_before_write: Both complete partitions of both teachers are fully read, validated and compared, then all common configs/settings/checkpoint are verified, before args.output.mkdir. Missing or mismatched input stops before creating merged outputs.
write_and_reload_review.output_layout: Creates four fresh roots under output/c1|own/train|validation. Existing output is rejected with exist_ok=False. Each config contains original shard roots/source_configs and each completion receipt retains original source_receipts.
write_and_reload_review.npz: np.savez_compressed serializes the validated arrays without dtype conversion or mathematical changes. Each NPZ is reopened and every saved array must exactly equal its in-memory source before completion is written. Helper positive fixtures also round-tripped actual M0 payloads through the same NumPy format.
write_and_reload_review.completion: Individual completion/job markers follow that root's successful reload. paired_cache_gate.json is written only after all four merged roots finish. Downstream sanity must require this final paired gate PASS, not merely one root's completion marker.
write_and_reload_review.no_automatic_fit: There is no subprocess, GPU, NN, optimizer or training call. Result explicitly sets training_started=false and official_goal_completed=false; the next milestone is matched B384 sanity, not automatic full fitting.

fixture_design.execution: Reviewer independently designed and directly executed the actual module's read_partition/verify_pair helpers using CPU NumPy in a private temporary directory. Candidate module was imported under a private name; main was never called and torch was never imported.
fixture_design.synthetic_metadata: The two actual M0 rows are copied into four one-row fixture shards with explicit CPU_FIXTURE_ONLY sequence IDs, so the ordering and duplicate-rejection invariants can be exercised. These are program fixtures, not collected experimental jobs; they make no benchmark/completion claim and are not eligible for real main's split checks.
positive_checks: controlled changes in both permitted future-label fields allowed
fixture_design.limits: Fixtures validate helper behavior and actual field compatibility. They do not establish that all16real inputs are complete, exercise main on unfinished caches, run the four-root real merge, or count as a training/benchmark result.

gate_conclusion: PASS for the reviewed CPU merger source and helpers. Run the actual merge only once all16real shard directories have completed. A successful actual paired_cache_gate and all four merged outputs may support the separately controlled matched B384 sanity milestone. No automatic training, full-fit acceptance, benchmark accuracy or research-goal completion is authorized or claimed by this review.

helper_fixture_receipt.fixture_scope: Actual two-row CLI M0 NPZ payloads copied into four one-row shards with synthetic CPU_FIXTURE_ONLY job IDs. Tests program behavior only; no collection/benchmark completion is claimed.
